name: Key Inspection Questions for Room Addition Contractors in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a Los Angeles County room additions contractor specifically about inspections and passing them the first time?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a Los Angeles County room additions contractor specifically about inspections and passing them the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inspections are a critical part of any room addition in Los Angeles County, and how a contractor handles them can affect both timeline and quality. When interviewing contractors, ask who is responsible for scheduling inspections and whether someone knowledgeable is always present to meet the inspector and answer questions. Request their approximate first-time pass rate for inspections on recent projects and what common issues they see. A good contractor should be able to describe typical inspection checkpoints—for foundation, framing, rough trades, insulation, and final—and how they prepare the site ahead of time. Ask for real examples of past correction notices: what went wrong, how they fixed it, and what they changed in their process to prevent recurrence. This reveals their honesty and commitment to learning. Confirm how they communicate inspection results with you and how inspection outcomes affect the schedule. If an inspection fails or is delayed, you should know quickly how that impacts subsequent work and any additional costs. Finally, ask if they pre-walk critical stages with their team before calling for inspection. Contractors who proactively inspect their own work usually have smoother interactions with city officials and fewer surprises for homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how they schedule inspections, what their pass rate is on first inspections, who meets inspectors on site, and how they handle correction notices. Request examples of past inspection issues and what they changed in their process to avoid repeats.
